generations.prompt:
Create ONE original TNR game AI avatar: OATHKEEPER, full body, head to feet, square 1:1, centered. Elite master of access seals and binding protocols aboard a lost top-secret shinobi warship. He is a tragic, aware chakra reconstruction still enforcing the final mission orders.

Tall, narrow, upright specialist silhouette. A restrained technical-duelist guard: knees slightly flexed, one hand held near the sternum in a precise two-finger oath gesture, the other held low within the body outline. Natural adult hands. Fitted near-black cross-wrap clothing, compact overlapping blackened iron chest plates, slim shoulder guards, a narrow divided knee-length armored tabard over tightly bound legs, plain dark leather belt, simple premodern boots. Both forearms densely encased in layered dark seal bindings and close iron splints with sparse abstract geometric grooves. No large weapon, no staff or floating scrolls. Weathered cloth, iron, lacquer and cord, carefully maintained despite age.

HEAD AND CURSE are the focal point: a lean mature man's brow and TWO natural sorrowful human eyes remain visible. Bare forehead, dark hair tied close with a few gray strands. Below the nose his living face has failed to reconstruct: the lower face is a single SMOOTH BLANK ASH-GRAY SEAL SURFACE, with no mouth or lips, no cloth folds, no mask straps. It joins a rigid blackened-iron THROAT COLLAR through a few narrow icy-white-blue seal edges. A small empty interruption immediately under the jaw makes the impossible reconstruction visible; pure green background is visible through it between two thin seal connections. No wound or gore. This is an altered, sealed face sustained by forbidden engineering, not a respirator. The human eyes convey grief and patient authority. Forearm bindings and collar have the same restrained pale seal accent; no other glow.

TNR style: crisp pixel lineart, flat cel shading, limited palette, soft even lighting, camera at eye level, flat 3/4 view, no low angle and no foreshortening, both arms held within the subject's own silhouette and touching nothing, at most one restrained elemental glow accent, as rim light on edges only. Near-black garment base with one icy-white-blue accent as narrow edge detail only. Cel shading with restrained painterly depth. Defined shadow shapes, flat mid-tones, no airbrush gradients and no bloom. Grounded adult proportions. Not chibi, not anime-scaled eyes. Fine pixel-edged contours and dark worn material texture; painted figures with pixel discipline. The figure must match the register of an armored, masked, cursed shinobi naval officer. Keep the lower-face seal and throat collar readable at a 320px display size.

Entire canvas is TRUE SOLID FLAT pure #00FF00 lime chroma, including every empty opening and the small reconstruction gap under the jaw. No cast shadow or floor. Full silhouette inside clean margins. Hard opaque pixel boundaries. No aura, halo, glow disc, light field, fog, bloom, smoke, transparent-preview checkerboard, green spill or background gradient. No scenery, ship, furniture, extra characters, text, labels, UI, border, watermark or grid. No headband, forehead protector, clan symbol, village insignia, real-world logo, skull, exposed bones, pirate clothing, gold ornament, crown, modern tactical vest, zippers, cybernetics, gas mask or modern machinery.
generations.visual_qc: Rejected before processing: lower face retained mouth/nose contours and the throat gap was too subtle.

generations.prompt:
Revise this single Oathkeeper avatar. Preserve the existing full-body pose, human eyes and brow, hair, fitted dark layered armor, long narrow divided tabard, bound forearms, hand gesture, legs, material texture and square composition. Maintain the crisp pixel lineart, flat cel shading, limited dark palette and true flat #00FF00 chroma background.

Correct ONLY the cursed lower-face and throat design so it cannot read as a normal wearable mask. The lower half of his face is now a smooth, perfectly MOUTHLESS ash-gray seal surface. Remove every suggestion of lips, mouth line, molded nose, cloth mask folds and mask straps. A shallow flat continuous plane from below the natural nose to the chin, with one faint narrow geometric seal groove, no engraved human features. Preserve the sorrowful natural eyes above it.

Make the reconstruction visibly impossible: between the chin and the rigid black iron throat collar, leave a CLEAR OPEN GAP about one third of the head's height. The entire flesh neck is absent in this gap; fill the opening with PURE #00FF00 green, not black. The intact head remains poised above the collar through TWO very thin angular icy-white-blue seal connections along the outer sides of this empty throat. No tubes, wires, physical metal spine or robotic joint in the opening. The rigid collar is intact at the base, with premodern iron seal plates and a dark cloth wrap below it. Clean, bloodless absence, no wound or severed flesh. The missing throat and still human eyes must remain clearly readable when the complete image is reduced to 320px.

The pale seal connections are solid narrow pixel shapes, not translucent glow. No aura, haze, bloom, light field or halo. No extra body damage, no new limbs, no new objects, no text, no insignia. Keep all empty openings pure green, no cast shadow on green. One character, full body, square 1:1, hard opaque boundaries.
